A '''Bith starship dealer''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] and sold two ships to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was disguised as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]]. The first was shot down by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the second only had enough fuel to make it to [[Unidentified Bith (Orondia station)|his brother's]] refueling station on [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]].<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />
